name: DrAnmar Suturable Tissue
purpose: A solver-neutral, deformable, open-incision tissue coupon for needle driving, suture capture, wound approximation, pullout and tissue-trauma research.

layers.role: tough outer surface and visual top layer

gaps.risk: age, anatomy, pathology, hydration, temperature and preparation produce large mechanical variation
gaps.mitigation: fit hierarchical distributions by tissue, site, patient cohort and preparation state

gaps.risk: the stable PhysX lane uses a linear tangent proxy and cannot reproduce full anisotropic visco-hyperelastic hysteresis
gaps.mitigation: retain the Ogden and Prony target contract and qualify PhysX, Newton and MPM against identical cyclic tests

gaps.risk: ordinary FEM contact does not create a persistent needle tract or allow arbitrary thread passage
gaps.mitigation: route puncture, cutting and stitch passage only to a topology-capable MPM backend

gaps.risk: compression, cutting, sweep and shaft-friction forces depend on needle geometry, drive path, speed and tissue tension
gaps.mitigation: calibrate force components from synchronized six-axis force and trajectory measurements

gaps.risk: holding strength depends on bite depth, spacing, layer engagement, thread friction and local damage
gaps.mitigation: fit local tract constraints and cohesive damage from pullout and cyclic loading by bite geometry

gaps.risk: real wound edges are irregular, pre-tensioned, perfused and may contain missing or crushed tissue
gaps.mitigation: version geometry and prestrain distributions from stereo reconstruction and specimen measurements

gaps.risk: blood and irrigation alter friction, visibility, tissue appearance and procedural decisions
gaps.mitigation: couple measured wet contact and fluid rendering only after mass-conservation and visibility probes pass

gaps.risk: jaw geometry, pressure, dwell time and repeated grasps cause local irreversible damage
gaps.mitigation: record contact pressure history per element and fit damage from instrumented grasp cycles

gaps.risk: subsurface scattering, specularity, smoke, fluid, exposure and compression change visual cues
gaps.mitigation: validate pose, wound-edge and puncture-site perception on held-out synchronized endoscopic video

gaps.risk: mesh density, time step, contact margins and solver iterations change force and failure results
gaps.mitigation: require mesh and time-step convergence with less than five percent change in qualified metrics

requirements.evidence: positive tetrahedral volume, two watertight components, explicit open incision and deterministic hashes
native PhysX and Newton finite-state, inversion, volume, contact and replay sweeps
single entry and exit, persistent tract, no unintended crossings and force-depth agreement
bite-dependent holding, cyclic damage, edge tearing and thread pull-through calibration
gap, eversion, pressure and tissue-damage agreement under held-out stitch patterns
held-out real-video wound-edge, needle, tract and thread pose errors by condition
independent clinical validation for the intended use

evidence.title: Experiment study on puncture force between MIS suture needle and soft tissue
evidence.used_for: puncture dependence on tissue, needle geometry, velocity and angle

evidence.title: Fracture Mechanics Model of Needle Cutting Tissue
evidence.used_for: fracture, spreading and friction contributions to insertion force

evidence.title: A biomechanical study of suture pullout in linea alba
evidence.used_for: bite size and tissue thickness dependence of suture holding strength
